CORE MATHEMATICS — MOCK EXAM #1
====

GRADE: Grade 11
SUBJECT: CORE MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Find the GCD of 25 and 37. (1 mark)
   A. 25
   B. 2
   C. 1
   D. 1

2. Solve for x: x + 3 = 8. (1 mark)
   A. 6
   B. 8
   C. 3
   D. 5

3. Find the GCD of 49 and 61. (1 mark)
   A. 2
   B. 49
   C. 1
   D. 1

4. What is √16? (1 mark)
   A. 16
   B. 5
   C. 4
   D. 8

5. A square plot has side 12 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 24
   B. 156
   C. 48
   D. 144

6. A square plot has side 6 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 36
   B. 24
   C. 12
   D. 42

7. Simplify 6x + 2 + 6x. (1 mark)
   A. 12x
   B. 12x + 2
   C. 6x + 2
   D. 6x

8. Find the GCD of 37 and 49. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 1
   C. 37
   D. 2

9. Which inequality means “x is greater than 5”? (1 mark)
   A. x = 5
   B. x < 5
   C. x > 5
   D. x ≥ 0 only

10. Find the GCD of 43 and 55. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 43
   C. 1
   D. 2

11. What is 4 × 6? (1 mark)
   A. 10
   B. 25
   C. 24
   D. 2

12. What is 4 × 4? (1 mark)
   A. 17
   B. 16
   C. 0
   D. 8

13. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 15 cm by 3 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 36
   B. 30
   C. 18
   D. 45

14. What is the square of 5? (1 mark)
   A. 5
   B. 26
   C. 10
   D. 25

15. Find the GCD of 31 and 43. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 31
   C. 2
   D. 1

16. Calculate 27 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 27
   B. 33
   C. 27.7
   D. 27.6

17. Which is greater: 1/4 or 1/2? (1 mark)
   A. 1/2
   B. 1/4
   C. They are equal
   D. Cannot tell

18. Calculate 31 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 37
   B. 31
   C. 31.7
   D. 31.6

19. A square plot has side 9 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 36
   B. 81
   C. 90
   D. 18

20. What is 4 × 8? (1 mark)
   A. 4
   B. 12
   C. 32
   D. 33

21. Calculate 15 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 15.6
   B. 15.7
   C. 15
   D. 21

22. In the number 3545, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 40
   B. 10
   C. 400
   D. 4

23. What is the square of 9? (1 mark)
   A. 18
   B. 9
   C. 81
   D. 82

24. In the number 3145, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 40
   B. 4
   C. 400
   D. 10

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
25. Show full working: A trader sells 13 items at Ksh 95 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

26. Show full working: A trader sells 14 items at Ksh 50 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

27. Show full working: A trader sells 15 items at Ksh 55 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

28. Show full working: A trader sells 16 items at Ksh 60 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

29. Show full working: A trader sells 17 items at Ksh 65 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

30. Show full working: A trader sells 18 items at Ksh 70 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

31. Show full working: A trader sells 19 items at Ksh 75 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

32. Show full working: A trader sells 12 items at Ksh 80 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)
